annotations.text:
THREE SECTIONS, THREE DIFFERENT INTERACTIONS.

Shipped: hover a card. A coloured ribbon draws across the top and the outcome rises out from under the text.

Applied AI: click a row. It unfolds, the number swells, the chevron turns. Five named areas instead of one vague heading.

Side projects: hover a row. The whole thing slides right and an arrow travels in from the left.

Career: chips, and the card fades in on every pick. Awards now show inside the year they were won.

CHANGED FROM YOUR NOTES

Cars is automotive. Pull request counts are gone entirely. Awards appear in the journey as well as the header, mapped to the year each was won. The 2026-dot-AI style tags are replaced with where and when, plus an outcome that appears on hover. Side projects have written names instead of repo slugs, and each links to its own repo.

STILL OPEN

LinkedIn's Featured section needs a login, so awards come from your portfolio doc. Paste the Featured items if they differ.

Dates for Express Scripts and Bank of America. Your email. The photo at img/kushal.jpg.
